note: The LISA 2022 Sektor 2000 shape (#1437): SCB has no VALUE row in 2022, `[[errata.delivered]]` adds the 2022 occurrence and a `[[coding.documented]]` entry states its list under version label 'Book', which book a lists. The documented label is the only 'Book' in the build, so it alone keeps the label rule from going stale.
fails_if: `_label_rule_bindings` (source_classification_bindings.py) reads a segment's labels only from the column's source claims: a documented segment cites a synthesized claim that is not among them, so the 2022 state binds no book; or `apply_classification_cases` stops adding segment labels to `matched_labels`, so `classifications/A.toml#/binding/value_set_labels/1` is reported `stale_curation_entry` although it bound

sources.description: SCB VALUE is documented in 2021 and 2023 under the value-set version 'Report' (codes 1/2) and has no row in 2022, when only ANCHOR is documented.
